No test files in PR — Stage 5 must add coverage before merge.
Card ownership not validated — customer_id and card data are taken from request body without verifying the authenticated user owns the card, enabling IDOR.
Input validation missing: card_id and customer_id are not checked for presence or format before use.
Input validation missing: card_id, customer_id, and step_up_token not validated for presence or format.
Input validation missing on query parameters (date_from, date_to) — no format or range validation enforcing the 24-month limit.
Running with ssl_context='adhoc' generates a self-signed cert; production should use a proper TLS certificate.
Compliance officer check is hard-coded to False, meaning the endpoint is permanently inaccessible — ensure RBAC integration is completed before release.
No unit or integration tests provided for any endpoint in this PR.
Audit log is only written to the application logger; no actual persistence to an immutable, tamper-evident store — 7-year retention AC is unmet.
